source: the editor's word of 27 Nov 2026 in the project thread (13:27 UTC): «В конце страницы Атласа я хочу секцию Changelog. Он пишется для людей, и предпочитает ясность и лаконичность точности и полноте.» — cloud thread, ticket 20261127-2; a generator change and the ledgers' lines for people

changelog.en: The page ends with this changelog.

fields.changelog: the colophon ends with a Changelog in each language (heading id changelog-<lang>, listed last in the contents): one dated line per change ledger after the first edition, newest first, from the ledger's `changelog` key {en, ru, he}, and one line per edition with its DOI; the lead line links CHANGELOG.md for the details

old.changelog: the page had no changelog: the Editions table gave each edition one sentence, and the site's updates since an edition were listed only in CHANGELOG.md in the repository

items.note: the editor's word: written for people, clarity and brevity before precision and completeness — a sentence or two per ledger, no process words (ledger, intake, ticket, decision ids); the full record stays CHANGELOG.md (ERRATA) and the ledgers themselves

fields.changelog lines: the `changelog` key added to the seventeen ledgers of 2 Oct – 26 Nov 2026, in English, Russian and Hebrew, each from the ledger's items and its CHANGELOG.md entry; the 20261123-2 table numbering, which has no ledger of its own, is named in the line of 23 Nov
fields.§6 Method / Provenance: the report's §6 Method line and the colophon's Provenance paragraph link the Changelog (changelog-<lang>) instead of naming «the changelog» / «the newest change ledger» without a place

fields.changelog-line: text_lint fails when a ledger dated after the first edition lacks its changelog line in a language of build/langs.py
